properties.description: Tests of tools/reflow2_design_copy.py. Eight hermetic cases on the guard, and three on the real binary (--bin) in a throwaway repository: the holder's copy is the live design without its hold; another branch's hold refuses the copy and nothing is written; a branch that does not contain main is refused. CI runs all eleven in the full job.
